title: WARRANT change record
description: `.warrant/changes/<change>.json` — governance state of one Change: classification, risk and recorded transitions (04 section 9). Written only by the CLI.

risk_source.description: Where a risk value came from: a deterministic floor rule (`floor` or `floor:<pack>:<rule-index>`), a proposer (`proposer` or `proposer:<id>`), a named human, or the previously recorded value (`record`, written by `warrant classify` when a repeated run keeps it).

risk_entry_data_loss.description: Value and source of the `data_loss` dimension.

ref.description: URL of the forge artefact recording the human approval of a value below the floor (REQ-KRN-028). Allowed only when `from` is `human:<login>`.

risk_entry_reversibility.description: Value and source of the `reversibility` dimension.

ref.description: URL of the forge artefact recording the human approval of a value below the floor (REQ-KRN-028). Allowed only when `from` is `human:<login>`.

risk_entry_blast_radius.description: Value and source of the `blast_radius` dimension.

ref.description: URL of the forge artefact recording the human approval of a value below the floor (REQ-KRN-028). Allowed only when `from` is `human:<login>`.

risk_entry_security_impact.description: Value and source of the `security_impact` dimension.

ref.description: URL of the forge artefact recording the human approval of a value below the floor (REQ-KRN-028). Allowed only when `from` is `human:<login>`.

risk_entry_compatibility.description: Value and source of the `compatibility` dimension.

ref.description: URL of the forge artefact recording the human approval of a value below the floor (REQ-KRN-028). Allowed only when `from` is `human:<login>`.

change.description: Change id: the OpenSpec change directory name without the archive date. Equal to the file name without `.json`.

change_state.description: Recorded lifecycle state of the Change.

classification.description: Profiles and risk assigned to the Change; every value carries its source.

profiles.description: Profile ids selected for this Change.

risk.description: Value and source per risk dimension (05 section 4).

data_loss.description: Risk of losing or corrupting data.

reversibility.description: How hard it is to undo the Change.

blast_radius.description: How far the effect of the Change reaches.

compatibility.description: Effect on existing consumers and contracts.

risk_level.description: Aggregate risk level derived from the dimensions.

transitions.description: Recorded transitions, oldest first. Each entry is an act, not a derivation.

by.description: Who recorded the transition, for example `cli:local`, `ci:run/8812` or `human:kat`.

effective_policy_hash.description: Hash of the effective policy the transition was evaluated against.

gates.description: Verdict of every gate of this transition, keyed by gate id.

ref.description: URL of the forge artefact recording the act, for example a pull request comment.

unknowns.description: Open questions recorded for this Change (02 section 1).

blocking.description: Whether implementation is forbidden until the question is resolved.

resolution.description: The answer that closed the question, once it was; the element is closed when it is non-empty.

resolved_as.description: Kind of the answer (02 section 1): a blocking UNKNOWN is closed only by `decision` with `ref` (REQ-KRN-035).

ref.description: URL of the maintainer's pull request comment whose text names this UNKNOWN id; verified by `warrant ci` (REQ-VER-013).

assumptions.description: Assumptions the work proceeds on (02 section 1).

amends.description: Changes whose accepted result this Change amends; each MUST be MERGED or ARCHIVED (ADR-0021).

items.description: Change id without the archive date.

supersedes.description: Changes this Change replaces; each MUST be ABANDONED (ADR-0021).

items.description: Change id without the archive date.
